recipe.title: Simple Chickpea and Spinach Salad
recipe.description: A quick and nutritious fresh salad combining raw spinach leaves and cooked chickpeas, seasoned lightly with their natural flavors.

ingredients.name: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

instructions: Wash the raw spinach thoroughly and gently pat dry with paper towels.
Place the raw spinach in a medium mixing bowl.
Add the cooked chickpeas to the bowl with the spinach.
Toss the ingredients together gently until evenly combined.
Divide the salad into two equal portions and serve immediately.
